request.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset: ONE PORTRAIT 9:16 cinematic keyframe for the Nasa myth El Trueno. Shot b7b: Agua sin varas.

IMAGE 1 IS THE EDIT TARGET. Preserve its exact scene, camera angle, frame composition, number of people, body positions, faces/ages, clothes, essential objects, terrain and day/night. Reconstruct its material and lighting as a photographed PHYSICAL MINIATURE BUILT ENTIRELY FROM CUT AND FOLDED PAPER. Other images are supporting references, never extra scene content. Images 2 and 3 are material anchors: physically folded cardstock garments, fingers and cliffs, miniature depth and tactile shadows. Image 4 is the updated triptych material and character reference, not a composition to copy. Any remaining images are already selected keyframes of this story: use their construction and matching identities, never import their different actions or props. The LAST reference is the earlier close view b5b. Make this final view match its shore angle, scale, palette and paper construction, while removing BOTH staffs and ALL circular contact ripples.

SCENE INVARIANTS FROM THE REVIEWED TARGET: Bookend aprobado: misma orilla y escala de b5b, dos varas y sus ondas desaparecidas. La nueva referencia semántica preserva composición sin repetir acción. Agua de papel mate, sin símbolos.
Keep all camera corrections already present in image 1. 

CONSTRUCTION, not illustrated texture: deep actual air gaps between paper layers, visible cut cardstock thickness, crisp fold creases, folded polygonal volumes and thin overlapping flaps. Human figures must read as handmade folded paper puppets: solid-color cut face planes, folded fingers, attached garment panels, no skin rendering. Match exact hats, shawls, cape, bags and staffs from target. Rocks are large angular FOLDED CARDSTOCK faces, not painted rock textures or tiny gravel. Leaves, if present, are separately cut paper bent from stems. Water is broad lifted blue paper sheets; mist/cloud/lightning is cut paper suspended in depth. No realistic liquid or vapor. Paper fibers subtle, never embossed filigree.

PHOTOGRAPHY: camera inside the miniature with no table, plinth, box or display edges. Raking soft light from the original direction, deep contact shadows, bright thin cut edges, real shadows cast by protruding paper. Focus on the main action; foreground corner and far scenery have optical miniature depth of field. Never blur important bodies or objects. Preserve target palette and time of day. Full frame ONE image, no text, letters, watermark or collage. No drawing outlines, illustration, brushwork, painted gradients, fabric weave, wood grain, plastic, clay, smooth CGI skin, shiny CGI, ornamental symbols or invented cultural motifs. Output vertical 9:16, preserve full composition and important subjects without cropping.
